digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot startup/runtime binding and per-operation snapshot composition
propositions: Startup deployment policy and static bindings are captured once at service initialization, while each operation/request receives a fresh non-secret OperationSnapshot with live runtime config.
MCP inbound bearer tokens remain request-scoped context variables and never enter startup snapshots, operation snapshots, logs, caches, or serialized schemas.

Review-bot validates decision-bearing auth (Gerrit/GitHub/LLM credentials) before accepting a job, fails closed on missing/revoked auth, and forwards the selected LLMRuntime to code review operations without principal fallback.
Static binding changes (env/file mutations) are not observed by running processes; only process restart/redeploy triggers re-binding, while native SDK-owned capability refresh remains in-process.
Partial or rejected Langfuse/OTLP telemetry setup disables observability with no-op graceful degradation and does not alter the underlying operation result; security-bearing auth remains fail-closed.
